name: PERDANA
recent: Perdana Petroleum 在2026年11月18日宣布独立非执行董事 Datuk Zakaria Bin Kasah 于11月16日辞职，并退出提名委员会主席等职务。公司同日发布2026财年第三季度业绩，净利同比大跌90%至392万令吉，主要因船只使用率下降。此外，公司近期多次因可赎回可转换优先股（RCPS）转换为普通股而发布附加上市公告。
notable: 独立非执行董事 Datuk Zakaria Bin Kasah 于2026年11月16日辞职，并卸任提名委员会主席等职务。
公司发布2026财年第三季度业绩，净利同比大跌90%至392万令吉。
公司因RCPS转换为普通股而多次发行新股并上市，最近一次上市日期为2026年11月12日。
risks: RCPS 持续转换为普通股，导致股本逐步扩大。
第三季度净利同比大幅下降90%，船只使用率下滑。
earnings: 2026财年第三季度（截至6月30日）营收为5348万令吉，环比增长26.8%，但同比下降35.8%；净利为377万令吉，同比下降89.1%，净利率为7.1%，较去年同期的负28.7%转正。

recent_en: Perdana Petroleum announced on 18 Nov 2026 the resignation of Independent Non-Executive Director Datuk Zakaria Bin Kasah effective 16 Nov 2026, ceasing as Chairman of the Nomination Committee and other roles. The company also reported 3Q 2026 net profit plunging 90% YoY to RM3.92 million, mainly due to lower vessel utilisation. Separately, the company made several additional listing announcements related to the conversion of Redeemable Convertible Preference Shares (RCPS) into ordinary shares.
notable_en: Independent Non-Executive Director Datuk Zakaria Bin Kasah resigned effective 16 Nov 2026, ceasing as Chairman of the Nomination Committee and other roles.
The company reported 3Q 2026 net profit plunging 90% YoY to RM3.92 million.
The company issued and listed new shares multiple times due to conversion of RCPS into ordinary shares, with the latest listing date on 12 Nov 2026.
risks_en: Continued conversion of RCPS into ordinary shares has led to gradual share capital expansion.
3Q net profit fell 90% YoY amid lower vessel utilisation.
earnings_en: For 3Q 2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was RM53.48 million, up 26.8% QoQ but down 35.8% YoY; net profit was RM3.77 million, down 89.1% YoY, with net margin at 7.1% versus negative 28.7% a year earlier.
